title: Gentle Work Around the Ankle
summary: Very light movements are made around the ankle over soft tissue.
goal: Create a transition between lower leg and foot.
startingPosition: The foot and lower leg are supported.
instructions: Stroke soft tissue around the joint.
direction: Around the joint over soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
